pages.text: A container for liquids that can (by default) hold up to 32 buckets. It's possible to restrict the type of liquids by placing a bucket with the specific liquid in the filter slot

pages.title: Using
pages.text: Right-click with buckets or other fluid containers to fill or drain the tank. Pipes can also interact with its fluid capability.

pages.title: Filter
pages.text: Put a filled bucket in the filter slot to lock the tank to that fluid. Remove the filter item to allow any fluid again.
